stimulus_summary: Use one CORSMiddleware instance for ordered OPTIONS preflights with a matching origin and method: first without PNA, then with Access-Control-Request-Private-Network: true while allow_private_network is false.
observation_selectors: response status; ordered response headers and body; downstream call trace; ordered ASGI events

source_item: CORS wrapper around the complete app
stimulus_summary: Wrap the complete Starlette app in CORSMiddleware; send an Origin request to an endpoint that raises an unhandled exception.
observation_selectors: response status; Access-Control-Allow-Origin and Vary headers; ASGI event order; exception propagation

stimulus_summary: Input-defined SessionMiddleware constructor and ordered HTTP requests; dynamically replay prior Set-Cookie values; observe request.session state, mutation flags, response headers, and ASGI events.
observation_selectors: request session values; accessed and modified flags; mutation result; ordered response headers including Set-Cookie and Vary; response bytes; ASGI event order

stimulus_summary: Wrap an ASGI app and send request scopes over http, https, ws, and wss schemes with host/path data; compare the redirect or pass-through behavior for each scheme.
observation_selectors: HTTP response status/headers and Location; downstream invocation; ordered WebSocket events

source_item: TrustedHost allowlists, wildcard matching, and www redirect
stimulus_summary: Use input-defined TrustedHostMiddleware allowlists and Host scopes for exact and wildcard matches, invalid-host rejection, default allow-any, and enabled/disabled www redirects.
observation_selectors: response status; ordered Location and content-type headers; response body bytes; downstream invocation and ASGI event order

stimulus_summary: Configure a non-negative max_body_size; send bodies below and above the limit with Content-Length present, missing, and understated, including fragmented chunks and multipart file/encoding bytes.
observation_selectors: response status/headers/body; receive event count; total body bytes; ASGI event order; multipart parser interaction

source_item: GZip standard and streaming response behavior
stimulus_summary: Configure minimum_size, compresslevel, and thread_minimum_size; send requests with and without gzip negotiation to standard and multi-chunk streaming endpoints at different chunk sizes.
observation_selectors: response headers; response body/chunk sequence; ASGI event order; compression thread identity

source_item: GZip content-type exclusions and passthrough cases
stimulus_summary: Configure default, replaced, and wildcard exclude_content_types; return responses with matching, non-matching, pre-encoded, event-stream, and partial-content metadata.
observation_selectors: Content-Encoding/Length/Vary headers; body bytes/chunks; status; ASGI event order

stimulus_summary: Define a subclass overriding async dispatch(request, call_next), configure it through Middleware, and issue HTTP requests to endpoints; include constructor configuration and keep per-request state local.
observation_selectors: request attributes observed by dispatch; downstream call trace; response status/headers/body; ASGI event order

stimulus_summary: Mutate an input-defined ContextVar in the endpoint under BaseHTTPMiddleware and a pure-ASGI control, with a surrounding pure-ASGI observer reading the value before and after downstream execution.
observation_selectors: surrounding observer ContextVar before/after values; middleware and endpoint ContextVar values; exact response status/headers/body; ordered ASGI events

source_item: Pure ASGI middleware callable and scope filtering
stimulus_summary: Wrap an ASGI app with a middleware callable receiving scope, receive, and send; exercise HTTP, WebSocket, and lifespan scopes plus a filtered HTTP-only or WebSocket-only case.
observation_selectors: scope type; receive/send message sequence; downstream invocation; exception/cancellation propagation

source_item: Using Request, data structures, and Response inside ASGI middleware
stimulus_summary: Construct request/data helpers from a supplied HTTP scope, inspect request fields, or invoke a Starlette response from middleware; vary query/header and response inputs.
observation_selectors: observed request fields; response status/headers/body; ASGI event order

source_item: Eager responses and wrapping arbitrary ASGI applications
stimulus_summary: Wrap an ASGI app; send one request that matches a middleware-owned path mapping and one that falls through, plus a non-HTTP scope.
observation_selectors: downstream invocation; response status/headers/body; event ordering by scope

source_item: Middleware placement on Mount, Route, WebSocketRoute, and Router
stimulus_summary: Configure the same observable middleware at app, mount, route, and router levels; send requests to included and excluded paths and a mounted app that raises.
observation_selectors: middleware invocation order; route/scope identity; exception handling boundary; response headers/body

exclusion_reason: This section lists separately maintained packages and integrations; it specifies no Starlette-owned runtime behavior to compare.
The asgiref example is a typing-only alternative; its annotations add no independent Starlette runtime behavior. Starlette-owned type aliases are covered by public signature/API review.
asgiref is presented as an external annotation alternative rather than a Starlette runtime feature or declared dependency.

stimulus_summary: Wrap a WSGI callable; supply an HTTP scope and request body, then observe how its WSGI response is bridged to ASGI.
observation_selectors: WSGI environ fields; ASGI response start/body sequence; response headers/status; task/thread cleanup

stimulus_summary: Import the input-named WSGI module in isolated source and package processes while capturing the emitted warning and import call site.
observation_selectors: warning category; message; import call-site filename and line; loaded module name

stimulus_summary: Run the session middleware import and a signed-cookie read/update flow in environments with and without the full-extra itsdangerous dependency.
observation_selectors: dependency availability; import outcome; cookie and request.session observations

source_item: full extra: python-multipart for multipart body-limit use
stimulus_summary: Install the full extra when testing multipart parsing, then POST a multipart body with file bytes and encoding overhead through RequestBodyLimitMiddleware.
observation_selectors: dependency availability; parser/import outcome; received raw byte total; ASGI response events

stimulus_summary: Inspect the pinned module exports and GZipMiddleware default argument for both the current constant spelling and the singular spelling mentioned by the TODO; instantiate with default and custom exclusions.
observation_selectors: exported symbol names; constructor default identity/value; import outcome

exclusion_reason: Shared pytest harness selects TestClient backends and constructs test clients; it is transport/test scaffolding, not an independent middleware consumer behavior. Translate each mapped middleware test into ASGI inputs without copying the harness.
The middleware test package marker contains no executable helper or independent parity behavior.

source_item: Inspecting or modifying HTTP request and WebSocket receive events
stimulus_summary: Wrap receive around HTTP and WebSocket apps; supply fragmented http.request events and websocket.receive messages, and vary scope type to exercise passthrough.
observation_selectors: downstream receive messages; request body byte/chunk observations; WebSocket receive events; downstream invocation

source_item: Inspecting or modifying HTTP and WebSocket send events
stimulus_summary: Wrap send to append response headers or inspect/alter HTTP response events and WebSocket sends; include response bodies whose length changes.
observation_selectors: send event order; repeated response headers; response body bytes; Content-Length; WebSocket send events

source_item: Passing middleware information through scope to endpoints
stimulus_summary: Add a uniquely namespaced scope value in middleware and issue an HTTP request to an endpoint that reads it.
observation_selectors: scope keys/values at middleware and endpoint; ASGI event order

stimulus_summary: Wrap an app that succeeds or raises with middleware using cleanup/finally or an async context manager; vary HTTP and WebSocket scopes as needed.
observation_selectors: entry/exit order; exception type/context; cleanup completion; ASGI event order

source_item: Keep connection-specific ASGI middleware state inside __call__
stimulus_summary: Issue overlapping requests with different response headers through middleware that keeps a request-specific flag in __call__; exercise both flagged and unflagged requests.
observation_selectors: per-request response body/header; cross-request state isolation; event order

source_item: Wrap middleware around arbitrary ASGI applications
stimulus_summary: Place a pure ASGI middleware around a non-Starlette ASGI app and around a Starlette app; send HTTP, WebSocket, and lifespan scopes.
observation_selectors: downstream scope/events; response and WebSocket event order; app identity/wrapper structure

stimulus_summary: Run the custom middleware error-propagation inputs with Python 3.10 using the exceptiongroup fallback and with Python 3.11+ using the built-in ExceptionGroup.
observation_selectors: Python version; exception type and group structure; propagated exception context; ASGI event order

stimulus_summary: Issue an HTTP session update, replay its live Set-Cookie value into a WebSocket scope, then accept and close the WebSocket from fixture-selected protocol values.
observation_selectors: loaded scope session mapping; accessed and modified flags; WebSocket event order; HTTP Set-Cookie replay source

stimulus_summary: Invoke SessionMiddleware with a lifespan scope; provide startup then shutdown and drive the downstream completion messages from the input action.
observation_selectors: scope/session observation; exact ordered ASGI lifecycle output events; absence of session access and modification
